comment: Module-api versions the integration fixtures are built against. One entry per host behaviour gate (see companion/lib/Instance/Connection/ApiVersions.ts), covering both sides of each gate. The runtime is the node version the manifest requests, matching what real modules of that era declare - keep node18 on the oldest entries so the still-supported legacy runtime keeps getting exercised. Regenerate the fixtures with: yarn tsx companion/test/integration/modules/build-module-fixtures.mts
